item.title: MIKE DAVIS: 30 years of Section 230 is more than enough
item.description: Thirty year ago, Congress passed Section 230 to protect startups, but now it shields Big Tech monopolies from accountability while enabling censorship.

item.description: International benchmark Brent Crude spiked on Monday amid growing fears of Middle East supply disruptions as the Iran conflict escalates.

item.description: U.S. energy security proves resilient, according to one analyst, as Iranian attacks disrupt Qatar LNG production and A domestic oil boom provides insulation from global shocks.

item.title: Airlines cancel flights, issue travel waivers over Middle East unrest
